comment: Waste of time. If you want a basket-weaving course then look no further. I'd recommend this to freshmen because it feels like a high school class. But for any upperclassmen, save yourself the boredom and take something else.
Children's Literature is the best class to take for a gen ed requirement! You get to read multiple children's books and analyze them. The final grade is also your choice.

Professor Gruner was extremely nice. Go see her because she reads revisions before hand. I wish I had done that and maybe I would have done better. If you don't, she grades hard so the best you can expect is a B/B+ on essays. Also, you don't learn much in terms of how to write; you mostly just read.

Prof Gruner is so down to earth and the kind of person I would like to have as my friend if we were the same age. Class is easy if you actually do the reading. Grading is a little hard on papers, but midterm and final aren't bad. Definitely recommend - i learned a lot

I loved Professor Gruner!!  I loved her class and it is still one of the best I have ever taken anywhere.  She really loves her students and teaching and her talent and cherrfulness really extends to the class.  She's fair but tough.  She really pushes you to do your best.  I recommend to anyone, especially those with an interest in writing.

She is very nice and the class is very easy - the material is fun and interesting and you want to read the books she assigns. The papers are easy and if you just do what she asks, you will get an easy A - midterm and final are a piece of cake

She's tough - she expects you to always keep up with the reading and have a really insightful for your papers.  Overall, I enjoyed the class, mostly because the class discussions were always engaging.

She's a great teacher and very helpful.  The class was very laid back and interesting.  There's a lot of discussion that goes on, so you can't skip out on any reading. She's also really helpful outside of class if you need it.
loved the class however it was not easy. Enjoyed the reading material however it was a lot. Again, don't expect the class to be easy.
Plays favorites big time.  Don't assume an easy A in children's lit.
Core is never that great, but she did a good job with it.  Not too much work.  I wish she realized/cared when no one did the reading.  big feminist.
